content: Dual ESM/CJS pitfalls: exports map errors caught by publint and attw (--pack) — missing types condition per block, ERR_REQUIRE_ESM masquerading, false ESM/CJS default-export shape changes, missing file extensions in ESM output, dual-instance state problem (package loaded twice via import+require breaks singletons/context). Fix: one build per format via tsup, types condition first, run publint+attw in CI before publish.
